data: What is the implementation of the C-DSR engine used in this platform, and how will it impact the results?

The C-DSR engine is implemented within the C-DSR Server block. It receives input from the Parser and the Configuration Controller CC. The engine processes this input and provides output to the Dialogue System DS and the Diagnostic Center DC. The History Log Center HLC also receives data from the engine. The impact of the C-DSR engine on the results would depend on its efficiency and accuracy in processing the input data, which could affect the overall performance and reliability of the system.
